entities.name: Abu Marwan Abd al-Malik I Saadi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Marwan Abd al-Malik I, often simply Abd al-Malik or Mulay Abdelmalek, was the Saadian Sultan from 1576 until his death right after the Battle of Alcácer Quibir against Portugal in 1578.
